//: Default Cynara API configuration. Connection strings and other secrets MUST come from environment variables (ConnectionStrings__Default, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.) — never from this file. For local development the defaults below point at the docker-compose Postgres stack; in any deployed environment the corresponding env var on the host overrides these values.

Cors.//: Origins allowed to call the API via browser fetch / XHR. Replace with the real cynara-web origin in the environment-specific override.

ConnectionStrings.//: The infrastructure layer picks one of these named connection strings based on ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: 'Production' selects 'Prod', any other value selects 'Default'. In deployed environments set ConnectionStrings__Prod (and optionally ConnectionStrings__Default) as env vars — they override these defaults without touching the file.

Hospitals.//: Bootstrap workspace created on first boot when AllowAutoBootstrap is true. HeaderName is the request header used to resolve the hospital tenant on every call.
